teaser.en: In the wet valleys below the Shimba Hills grows a wild relative of the palm that fills supermarket shelves worldwide with oil.
teaser.sw: Katika mabonde yenye maji chini ya Milima ya Shimba huota ndugu wa porini wa mchikichi unaojaza rafu za maduka makubwa duniani kote kwa mafuta.

summary.en: *Mtsikitsi*, the wild oil palm, is a feather palm of wet valley bottoms and stream sides on the south coast. Its orange-red fruits give palm oil, and it is also tapped for palm wine.
summary.sw: *Mtsikitsi*, yaani mchikichi wa porini, ni mmea wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani kama manyoya unaoota katika mabonde yenye maji na kando ya vijito katika pwani ya kusini. Matunda yake ya rangi ya machungwa-nyekundu hutoa mafuta ya mawese, na pia hugemwa kupata tembo.

about.en:
*Mtsikitsi* is a single-stemmed feather palm. The trunk is rough with the stubs of old leaf bases, and the leaf stalks are spiny. The crown holds long, arching fronds.

The fruits grow in dense, heavy bunches tucked among the leaf bases. Each fruit is small and plum-shaped, ripening to orange-red, with an oily pulp around a hard kernel.
about.sw:
*Mtsikitsi* ni mmea wa jamii ya mnazi wenye shina moja na majani kama manyoya. Shina lake limekwaruzika kwa visiki vya vikonyo vya majani ya zamani, na vikonyo vya majani vina miiba. Kilele chake kina makuti marefu yaliyopinda.

Matunda huota katika vichala vizito vilivyosongamana, vilivyojificha kati ya vikonyo vya majani. Kila tunda ni dogo na lenye umbo la plamu, huiva na kuwa la rangi ya machungwa-nyekundu, na lina nyama yenye mafuta inayozunguka kokwa gumu.

where.en: It grows in wet valley bottoms and along streams on the south coast, such as at the foot of the Shimba Hills and around Msambweni. Look for its feathery crown above the green of a valley floor.
where.sw: Huota katika mabonde yenye maji na kando ya vijito katika pwani ya kusini, kama vile chini ya Milima ya Shimba na kuzunguka Msambweni. Utakiona kilele chake chenye majani kama manyoya juu ya ukijani wa sakafu ya bonde.

uses.en: Oil is pressed from the fruit. The palm is also tapped for palm wine, and its leaves are used.
uses.sw: Mafuta hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye tunda. Mmea huu pia hugemwa kupata tembo, na majani yake hutumika.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsikitsi* and describes it as the 'wild oil palm'. The Mgombato dictionary also gives *mtsikitsi* for the wild or Guinea oil palm, and notes that the same word is used for cycads. Pakia uses *mtsikitsi* for the raffia palm too, so the name covers more than one plant. In Swahili it is *mchikichi* (Mgombato adds *mchikichi wa bara*) or *mwese*. In English it is the oil palm, and its scientific name is *Elaeis guineensis*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsikitsi* na kuueleza kama 'mchikichi wa porini'. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia inatoa *mtsikitsi* kwa mchikichi wa porini au wa Guinea, na inaeleza kwamba neno hilohilo hutumika kwa *cycads*. Pakia anatumia *mtsikitsi* kwa mwale (*raffia palm*) pia, hivyo jina hili linahusu zaidi ya mmea mmoja. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mchikichi* (Mgombato anaongeza *mchikichi wa bara*) au *mwese*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *oil palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Elaeis guineensis*.

reason.en: The raffia palm, which shares the name mtsikitsi
A cycad: Mgombato says mtsikitsi is also used for cycads
reason.sw: Mmea wa jamii ya cycad: Mgombato anasema mtsikitsi hutumika pia kwa cycads

reason.en: Another palm tapped for palm wine
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa jamii ya mnazi unaogemwa kupata tembo

reason.en: Another palm of wet valleys and stream banks
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa jamii ya mnazi wa mabonde yenye maji na kingo za vijito

mgombato: mtsikitsi (mi) type of plant: wild oil palm, Guinea oil palm (Elaeis guineensis); also used of cycads; mchikichi (wa bara), miwese.
